Erica: Quick all-hands follow-up re: infra talk. Post short clarifying Qs about GPU supply, regions, and autoscale.
Sam: TL;DR: hosted pool OK for near term. APAC spot volatility could delay some endpoint launches; we've reserved a small SG committed pool and an EU buffer for critical routes.
Diego: For Dedicated customers, can we offer pre-warmed reservations for launches?
Vikram: Yes — reservation API exists. Well add a CLI helper and a TTL-based prewarm flow so CS can request pre-warm for a window.
Lina: Autoscale: we saw oscillation last quarter on promo spikes. Any config changes?
Sam: Plan: introduce a 30s spike absorber (token bucket) + stepwise scaling with adaptive cooldown. Reduces churn vs immediate large scale-outs.
Diego: If we spill to EU due to APAC shortage, what happens to latency targets and billing?
Sam: Soft-fail spill keeps latency SLO raw target but adds a "served_from" annotation and billing flag. For Hosted we'll absorb brief spills; persistent cross-region serving triggers alerts and billing notices. Dedicated can opt into auto-failover or require manual approval.
Vikram: Procurement: A100 reorder ETA ~8w. H100 pilot target Q3 pending kernel validation. We're negotiating committed pools with two providers to reduce APAC risk.
Erica: Who owns emergency manual capacity bumps?
Vikram: capacity-ops approves; infra-oncall executes. We'll add a Slack shortcut to request an emergency bump and a short runbook. Lina to own runbook edits.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Actions recorded: sam/procurement-note, vikram/prewarm-cli + runbook, lina/runbook-update, diego/prewarm-request
Sam: I'll post the procurement note and the committed pool details in #eng-ops today. Thanks all.
